Advantages of CNC Technology CNC technology offers a wide range of advantages that make it essential to modern manufacturing. By combining computer-controlled automation with high-performance machinery, CNC systems significantly improve manufacturing efficiency. They also enable superior quality and scalability across diverse industries. High Precision and Consistent Accuracy One of the most significant advantages of CNC technology is its ability to deliver extremely high precision. CNC technology can repeatedly produce components with tight tolerances that are difficult or impossible to achieve through manual machining. Once a program is validated, the same dimensions and surface quality can be maintained across thousands of parts, ensuring consistent accuracy even in complex geometries. This level of precision is especially critical in industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and electronics, where small dimensional deviations can affect performance, safety, or compliance with industry standards. Increased Production Efficiency CNC technology dramatically improves production efficiency by automating machining operations. Machines can run continuously with minimal operator intervention, reducing setup time and accelerating production cycles. Multi-axis CNC systems further enhance efficiency by completing multiple operations—such as milling, drilling, and contouring—in a single setup. Automated tool changes, optimized tool paths, and high-speed machining capabilities allow manufacturers to shorten lead times and respond quickly to changing production demands. Excellent Repeatability and Quality Control Repeatability is a core strength of CNC technology. Every part produced from the same CNC program is virtually identical, minimizing variation and reducing scrap rates. This repeatability simplifies quality control processes, as fewer manual inspections are required once a process is stabilized. CNC systems also integrate easily with in-process measurement and inspection technologies, enabling real-time quality monitoring and early detection of deviations before defects occur. Material and Design Versatility CNC technology supports a wide range of materials, including metals, plastics, composites, and engineered alloys. From aluminum and stainless steel to advanced polymers and titanium, CNC machines can be optimized to handle different cutting characteristics and surface finish requirements. A common example is aluminum CNC machining , which is widely used due to aluminum’s excellent machinability and strength-to-weight ratio. In addition, CNC technology enables the machining of complex shapes, internal features, and intricate contours that would be extremely time-consuming or impractical with conventional methods. This design freedom allows engineers to innovate without being limited by manufacturing constraints. Scalability from Prototyping to Mass Production Another key advantage of CNC technology is its scalability. The same CNC setup can be used for rapid prototyping, small-batch production, and high-volume manufacturing with minimal modification. Design changes can be implemented quickly by updating the digital program rather than retooling entire production lines. This flexibility is particularly valuable for startups, R&D teams, and manufacturers operating in fast-moving markets where product iterations are frequent. Reduced Labor Dependency and Improved Safety By automating machining tasks, CNC technology reduces reliance on manual labor and lowers the risk of human error. Operators are less exposed to cutting tools and moving machine components, resulting in a safer working environment. Modern CNC systems also feature built-in safety controls, error detection, and machine monitoring functions that further protect both personnel and equipment while maintaining stable production. Cost Efficiency Over the Product Lifecycle While CNC machines require an initial investment, they offer long-term cost advantages. Reduced material waste, lower rework rates, shorter production times, and improved machine utilization all contribute to a lower cost per part over the product lifecycle. For manufacturers seeking consistent quality, predictable output, and efficient resource usage, CNC technology represents a cost-effective solution that supports sustainable growth. Applications of CNC Technology in Manufacturing CNC technology has a wide range of applications across industries due to its ability to deliver high precision, consistency, and production efficiency. From large-scale industrial manufacturing to rapid prototyping, CNC technology continues to expand as materials, software, and machine capabilities evolve. Applications in Metalworking CNC milling machines, lathes, and laser cutters handle metals like aluminum, steel, and titanium with unmatched precision. These machines reduce manual labor, minimize errors, and allow for complex shapes that meet rigorous industry standards. In metalworking industries where tolerance control and material consistency are critical, CNC technology enables reliable production of complex metal components at scale. Applications in Plastics and Woodworking Beyond metals, CNC routers can cut, engrave, and shape plastic components or wood panels with high accuracy. Routers are typically used for wood and plastic materials, while milling machines are better suited for metal machining due to their rigidity and cutting capabilities. Manufacturers can efficiently produce prototypes and mass-produced items, lowering production costs and turnaround times. Industrial Applications Industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, energy, and heavy machinery rely on CNC systems to produce structural components, housings, brackets, and precision parts. CNC machining ensures tight tolerances, repeatability, and high reliability for critical components. Prototyping and Small Batch Production Rapid prototyping and small-batch CNC production allow engineers to quickly transform digital designs into functional prototypes, enabling faster design validation, iterative testing, and reduced time-to-market. Innovative Uses in Various Industries Advanced applications such as multi-axis cutting, hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing, and complex 3D contour machining expand possibilities in medical devices, architecture, and custom design. CNC Machine Technology Types of CNC Machines CNC machine technology includes milling machines, lathes, routers, plasma cutters, and laser engraving systems. Each type serves a specific function, from cutting and drilling to shaping and engraving, meeting diverse manufacturing needs. How CNC Machines Work CNC machines operate by translating digital designs into precise machining actions through integrated control systems. This enables highly accurate and repeatable production while minimizing material waste and optimizing workflow efficiency. Maintenance and Optimization Proper maintenance of CNC machines is essential for long-term performance. Regular calibration, tool replacement, and software updates optimize machine efficiency and prevent downtime. Skilled operators can further enhance productivity by choosing the right tooling and machining parameters. Industrial CNC Technology Automation in Large-Scale Production Industrial CNC technology enables full automation of production lines. Large-scale manufacturing can run continuously with minimal human supervision, improving throughput and reducing labor costs. Integration with Industrial Processes CNC technology integrates seamlessly with industrial processes such as assembly, quality inspection, and material handling. This integration allows for smarter factories, streamlined workflows, and higher overall efficiency. Case Studies Industries adopting industrial CNC technology have reported reduced production errors, faster turnaround times, and improved product consistency. For example, automotive suppliers use CNC machines to produce engine components with precise tolerances, enhancing vehicle performance and reliability. CNC Technology Services Design and Consulting Services CNC technology services extend beyond machining itself. Design and consulting services help manufacturers apply CNC technology effectively by optimizing material selection, machining strategies, and process planning before production begins. Manufacturing and Prototyping Services Service providers offer CNC machining for both prototypes and mass production. This allows businesses to outsource specialized tasks, reduce overhead, and maintain high-quality standards. Maintenance and Support Services Many CNC technology service providers also offer ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and training. This ensures clients can maintain efficient operations, extend machine lifespan, and minimize production delays. Future Trends in CNC Technology Beyond basic CNC operation and machine control, future CNC technology development is increasingly driven by intelligence, connectivity, and system-level integration. Future developments will not only improve precision and productivity but also fundamentally reshape how factories operate, how products are designed, and how manufacturers compete in global markets. Smart CNC and AI Integration The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with CNC systems is transforming machining from reactive automation into predictive and adaptive manufacturing. AI-powered algorithms can analyze historical machining data. They automatically optimize tool paths, reduce cycle times, and minimize tool wear. Machine learning models are increasingly used to detect subtle signs of tool degradation or misalignment before they cause defects. In aerospace and medical device manufacturing, where tolerances are extremely tight, AI-assisted CNC tool path optimization is already being adopted to ensure consistency and precision across complex geometries. Over time, smart CNC machines will be able to adjust cutting strategies in real time, self-correcting for material inconsistencies and dynamic load variations without human intervention. IoT and Connected Manufacturing The rise of the Internet of Things (IoT) enables CNC machines to become integral components of connected smart factories. Sensors embedded in CNC equipment collect real-time data on temperature, vibration, spindle load, and tool life. This data, streamed through secure networks, feeds into centralized manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to support real-time monitoring and informed decision-making. Connected CNC machines can automatically schedule maintenance based on actual usage patterns, reducing unplanned downtime. In facilities with multiple machines producing different parts, IoT connectivity enhances workflow coordination, material tracking, and quality control, leading to higher operational efficiency and lower production costs. Advanced Materials and Machining Techniques As new materials continue to emerge, CNC technology evolves to address the challenges they present. Advanced composites, high-entropy alloys (HEAs) , and next-generation polymers have unique machining requirements. High-entropy alloys are composed of multiple principal elements in near-equal proportions, offering exceptional strength, wear resistance, and thermal stability. These materials are increasingly used in aerospace and energy applications, where CNC machining must precisely control cutting forces and heat generation to maintain part integrity. CNC technology is also incorporating hybrid manufacturing techniques that combine additive manufacturing (3D printing) with traditional subtractive machining. These hybrid processes allow complex internal structures to be built additively and then finished with high-precision CNC cutting, making them ideal for lightweight aerospace components and customized medical implants. Human–Machine Collaboration and Augmented Reality Future CNC environments will emphasize human–machine collaboration, where operators work alongside intelligent machining systems rather than simply monitoring them. Augmented reality (AR) tools will support setup, training, and maintenance by overlaying digital instructions directly onto physical machinery. Technicians wearing AR headsets will be guided step-by-step through complex calibration or repair processes, reducing training time and lowering the risk of error. Furthermore, virtual simulation environments will allow engineers to preview machining operations before any material is cut. This not only helps validate designs but also ensures that tooling and fixturing are optimized for efficiency and safety. Conclusion Summary of Key Benefits CNC technology has transformed modern manufacturing by improving precision, efficiency, and flexibility. It enables complex machining, reduces errors, and accelerates production cycles. Impact on Modern Manufacturing With industrial CNC technology, advanced machines, and comprehensive services, manufacturers can achieve high-quality output, innovate rapidly, and maintain a competitive edge. As CNC technology continues to evolve, its influence on the manufacturing industry will only grow stronger. events.before: Home Newsroom Notice on the Upcoming EU Tax Reform Effective July 2026 Notice on the Upcoming EU Tax Reform Effective July 2026 Press Release Jun 27, 2026 Table of Contents Policy Overview: Elimination of Duty Exemptions Different sets of rules will apply to B2C and B2B shipments Managing "Duty & Tax Disbursement Fees" from Carriers Consolidation Advice for B2C Shipments An official advisory has been issued for customers across the European Union regarding the upcoming EU Tax Reform . Effective July 1, 2026 , this major regulatory shift implemented by the European Union will impact import and customs procedures for low-value shipments entering EU member states. To ensure uninterrupted service and minimize clearance delays, all EU-based clients are urged to familiarize themselves with these new regulations. Policy Overview: Elimination of Duty Exemptions Starting July 1, 2026, the European Union will completely eliminate the customs duty exemption for low-value goods . Every single shipment bound for the EU, regardless of its value, must be formally declared and is subject to customs duties. Different sets of rules will apply to B2C and B2B shipments The EUCR introduces distinct compliance frameworks based on the nature of the recipient: 1. For B2C shipments : Goods value ≤ €150 : A flat-rate "temporary customs duty" of €3.00 per line item will be applied. For example, if a package contains 3 different product categories, the total temporary customs duty will be €9.00. Goods value > €150 : Standard tariff rates apply. Impact on IOSS : Under the current IOSS framework, JLCCNC can only collect and remit import VAT, but cannot manage the "temporary customs duty". Therefore, recipients will still need to pay the "temporary customs duty" upon importation if using non-DDP channels. 2. For B2B shipments : Regardless of the shipment value, all B2B packages must go through formal customs clearance and pay duties based on the actual HS code corresponding to the goods (standard applicable tariff rates), bypassing the €3.00 flat-rate rule. Managing "Duty & Tax Disbursement Fees" from Carriers When carriers like DHL, UPS, or FedEx pay customs duties and taxes upfront on behalf of the recipient, they charge a "duty & tax disbursement fee" to the party responsible for the tax. These fees vary significantly by country and carrier (such as tiered brackets or specific minimum charges per shipment). Consolidation Advice for B2C Shipments To optimize your shipping costs under the new EU regulations, we highly recommend consolidating your orders. For B2C customers, if you combine multiple items or orders into a single shipment to bring the total goods value above €150 , the shipment will become eligible for standard tariff rates instead of the €3.00 flat-rate temporary customs duty per line item. For many multi-item orders, utilizing standard tariffs through consolidation can be significantly more cost-effective. For more information regarding specific handling fees, tax calculations, and country-by-country Duty & Tax Disbursement Fee, please read our full EU Customs Reform (EUCR) July 2026 – Client FAQ . Managing "Duty & Tax Disbursement Fees" from Carriers When carriers like DHL, UPS, or FedEx pay customs duties and taxes upfront on behalf of the recipient, they charge a "duty & tax disbursement fee" to the party responsible for the tax. These fees vary significantly by country and carrier (such as tiered brackets or specific minimum charges per shipment). Consolidation Advice for B2C Shipments To optimize your shipping costs under the new EU regulations, we highly recommend consolidating your orders. For B2C customers, if you combine multiple items or orders into a single shipment to bring the total goods value above €150 , the shipment will become eligible for standard tariff rates instead of the €3.00 flat-rate temporary customs duty per line item. For many multi-item orders, utilizing standard tariffs through consolidation can be significantly more cost-effective. For more information regarding specific handling fees, tax calculations, and country-by-country Duty & Tax Disbursement Fee, please read our full EU Customs Reform (EUCR) July 2026 – Client FAQ . events.before: Home Newsroom JLC Technology Group Launches USDC Payments for Faster, Lower-Fee Checkout JLC Technology Group Launches USDC Payments for Faster, Lower-Fee Checkout Press Release Aug 27, 2026 Table of Contents Faster and Lower-Cost Payments with USDC USDC Payment Availability How to Pay with USDC USDC Payment FAQs Supporting a More Flexible Digital Manufacturing Experience About JLC Technology Group About JLCCNC We are thrilled to announce that JLC Technology Group now officially accepts stablecoin payments . US-based customers can now pay for JLCCNC, JLC3DP, JLCPCB, and JLCMC orders using USDC—enabling near-instant settlement, lower transaction fees, and 24/7 availability. Faster and Lower-Cost Payments with USDC Paying with stablecoins brings several tangible advantages directly to customers: Lower transaction costs – Customers only pay the blockchain network fee (Gas fee), which is typically a fraction of a dollar on networks like Solana or Polygon. There are no cross-border surcharges or hidden bank fees. No bank account or credit card required – Customers only need a crypto wallet, such as MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet. Fast and straightforward checkout – Customers can select stablecoin at checkout, connect their wallet, and confirm the transaction in just a few clicks, without entering lengthy card details or bank information. In short, USDC payments provide lower fees, instant processing, and a smoother checkout experience. USDC Payment Availability The current stablecoin payment setup includes the following conditions: Item Current Rule Supported business JLCPCB, JLC3DP, JLCCNC, and JLCMC Supported region United States only Supported stablecoin USDC only Supported networks Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Base Maximum per transaction Up to 10,000 USD Refund options Original wallet or JLC balance These rules reflect JLC's current stablecoin payment setup. Customers outside the United States will not see the USDC payment option at this stage. Any future expansion of supported regions will be announced separately. This launch supports USDC only . Other stablecoins, including USDP and USDG, are not currently supported. How to Pay with USDC Paying with stablecoins is simple and requires four steps. Step 1: Select Payment Method at Checkout On the JLC order confirmation page, select "Crypto (USDC)" . Step 2: Connect Your Crypto Wallet Customers will be redirected to a secure payment page, where they can connect using MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet , or any WalletConnect-compatible wallet. Step 3: Confirm and Sign the Transaction The payment page displays the amount due, denominated in USDC and pegged 1:1 to USD. Customers can confirm and sign the transaction in their wallet. Step 4: Payment Complete Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the order status will update automatically. Funds are settled in USD to JLC's account — JLC does not hold or manage any cryptocurrency. USDC Payment FAQs Q1: Which stablecoins are currently supported? USDC only. Other stablecoins, including USDT, USDP, and USDG, are not currently supported. Q2: Are there fees for stablecoin payments? Customers are responsible for the Gas fees (network transaction fees) of the chosen blockchain network. Fees vary by network — Solana, Polygon, and Base offer extremely low fees, often just a few cents. JLC Technology Group does not charge any additional fees for stablecoin payments. Q3: Is there a transaction limit? The per-transaction limit is 10,000 USD. Orders exceeding this amount are not eligible for stablecoin payment and require an alternative payment method. Q4: Are refunds supported? Yes. Refunds are processed back to the customer's original wallet or to the customer's JLC balance, subject to customer setup. Q5: Which regions are supported? Currently, stablecoin payments are available only for customers in the United States. Other countries are not supported at this time. Q6: How long does a stablecoin payment take to confirm? Confirmation time varies by network. Ethereum typically takes 3–15 minutes, while Solana, Polygon, and Base usually confirm within 5–30 seconds. During network congestion, times may be longer. Customers are recommended to use faster networks like Solana or Polygon for the quickest experience. Supporting a More Flexible Digital Manufacturing Experience The launch of USDC payments provides US-based customers with another way to complete orders across JLC Technology Group's digital manufacturing ecosystem. By supporting stablecoin payments, JLCCNC and other JLC platforms provide customers with a payment option designed around faster processing, lower transaction costs, and 24/7 availability. About JLC Technology Group Founded in 2006, JLC Technology Group provides integrated electronics and mechanical manufacturing services to more than 9.5 million customers across over 180 countries and regions. Its ecosystem includes EasyEDA for PCB design, JLCPCB for PCB fabrication and assembly, JLC3DP for additive manufacturing, JLCCNC for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, and JLCMC for mechanical components—enabling customers to move from prototype to production through a full-stack digital manufacturing platform. About JLCCNC JLCCNC is an online manufacturing platform providing professional CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication services for engineers, product developers, businesses, and makers worldwide. With a range of manufacturing capabilities and materials, JLCCNC helps customers accelerate prototyping and production with quality, speed, and affordability. As part of JLC Technology Group , JLCCNC provides customers with access to the group's integrated digital manufacturing ecosystem, including electronics manufacturing, 3D printing, and mechanical components. events.before: Home Newsroom JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification Press Release Jul 24, 2026 Table of Contents Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers Secure Payment Infrastructure Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing About JLC Digital Manufacturing JLC Digital Manufacturing has achieved Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0.1 Level 1 certification , the highest level of PCI DSS compliance. The certification covers the company's major overseas business platforms, including JLCCNC, JLCPCB, JLC3DP, and JLCMC , reinforcing payment security and data protection for customers worldwide. The certification was independently assessed by atsec information security , a Qualified Security Assessor (QSA). This achievement builds upon JLC Digital Manufacturing's previously obtained ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy Information Management System certifications, further strengthening the company's information security governance framework and its commitment to secure cross-border digital services. Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers PCI DSS is the internationally recognized security standard established by major international payment card brands, including Visa and MasterCard, to protect payment card information. Version 4.0.1 establishes comprehensive security requirements covering areas such as network protection, encryption, access control, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and governance. By achieving PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 certification, JLC Digital Manufacturing demonstrates that its payment security controls have been independently assessed against internationally recognized industry standards. For customers, this certification provides additional confidence that payment information is protected according to globally accepted security requirements throughout the online transaction process. Secure Payment Infrastructure JLC Digital Manufacturing protects online payments through industry-standard encryption, secure tokenization technologies, and trusted payment service providers, including Stripe and PayPal. The company's payment architecture is designed to protect cardholder information during transmission while reducing the handling of sensitive payment data within its own systems. In accordance with PCI DSS requirements, JLC Digital Manufacturing does not store unencrypted cardholder data, helping minimize potential security risks. These security measures support the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of payment information for customers conducting business through the company's global digital platforms. Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing As AI technologies and intelligent manufacturing continue to accelerate the evolution of the electronics industry, cybersecurity and payment security have become increasingly important across global supply chains. For JLC Digital Manufacturing, protecting customer information and enabling secure online transactions are fundamental to delivering reliable digital manufacturing services. With internationally recognized certifications including ISO/IEC 27001 , ISO/IEC 27701 , and PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 , JLC Digital Manufacturing will continue enhancing its security capabilities while providing trusted services for engineers, innovators, and businesses worldwide. About JLC Digital Manufacturing Founded in 2006, JLC Digital Manufacturing provides integrated electronics and mechanical manufacturing services to more than 9.5 million customers across over 180 countries and regions . Its ecosystem includes JLCCNC for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, EasyEDA for PCB design, JLCPCB for PCB fabrication, component sourcing, and PCB assembly, JLC3DP for additive manufacturing, and JLCMC for mechanical components, enabling customers to move from prototype to production through a full-stack digital manufacturing platform. For JLCCNC customers, this certification provides additional assurance that online payment information is protected according to internationally recognized security standards. events.after: Home Newsroom JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification Press Release Jul 24, 2026 Table of Contents Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers Secure Payment Infrastructure Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing About JLC Digital Manufacturing JLC Digital Manufacturing has achieved Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0.1 Level 1 certification , the highest level of PCI DSS compliance. The certification covers the company's major overseas business platforms, including JLCCNC, JLCPCB, JLC3DP, and JLCMC , reinforcing payment security and data protection for customers worldwide. The certification was independently assessed by atsec information security , a Qualified Security Assessor (QSA). This achievement builds upon JLC Digital Manufacturing's previously obtained ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy Information Management System certifications, further strengthening the company's information security governance framework and its commitment to secure cross-border digital services. Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers PCI DSS is the internationally recognized security standard established by major international payment card brands, including Visa and MasterCard, to protect payment card information. Version 4.0.1 establishes comprehensive security requirements covering areas such as network protection, encryption, access control, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and governance. By achieving PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 certification, JLC Digital Manufacturing demonstrates that its payment security controls have been independently assessed against internationally recognized industry standards. For customers, this certification provides additional confidence that payment information is protected according to globally accepted security requirements throughout the online transaction process. Secure Payment Infrastructure JLC Digital Manufacturing protects online payments through industry-standard encryption, secure tokenization technologies, and trusted payment service providers, including Stripe and PayPal. The company's payment architecture is designed to protect cardholder information during transmission while reducing the handling of sensitive payment data within its own systems. In accordance with PCI DSS requirements, JLC Digital Manufacturing does not store unencrypted cardholder data, helping minimize potential security risks. These security measures support the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of payment information for customers conducting business through the company's global digital platforms. Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing As AI technologies and intelligent manufacturing continue to accelerate the evolution of the electronics industry, cybersecurity and payment security have become increasingly important across global supply chains. For JLC Digital Manufacturing, protecting customer information and enabling secure online transactions are fundamental to delivering reliable digital manufacturing services. With internationally recognized certifications including ISO/IEC 27001 , ISO/IEC 27701 , and PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 , JLC Digital Manufacturing will continue enhancing its security capabilities while providing trusted services for engineers, innovators, and businesses worldwide. About JLC Digital Manufacturing Founded in 2006, JLC Digital Manufacturing provides integrated electronics and mechanical manufacturing services to more than 9.5 million customers across over 180 countries and regions . Its ecosystem includes JLCCNC for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, EasyEDA for PCB design, JLCPCB for PCB fabrication, component sourcing, and PCB assembly, JLC3DP for additive manufacturing, and JLCMC for mechanical components, enabling customers to move from prototype to production through a full-stack digital manufacturing platform. For JLCCNC customers, this certification provides additional assurance that online payment information is protected according to internationally recognized security standards. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Participates in Hannover Messe 2025 JLCCNC Participates in Hannover Messe 2025 Press Release Mar 10, 2025 JLCCNC will exhibit at Hannover Messe from 31 March to 4 April 2025 at Hannover Messe in Germany. With the theme of ‘Energising A Sustainable Industry’, JLC Global will be showcasing its full range of technologies in 3D printing, CNC machining, Mechanical Components, PCB, PCBA and PCB design software development in Hall 17, Booth B12, demonstrating its expertise in smart manufacturing and digital transformation. It demonstrates its leading strength in the field of intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation. Exhibition Information · Event Theme : Hannover Messe 2025 - "Energizing A Sustainable Industry" · Dates : March 31 to April 4, 2025 · Location : Hannover Exhibition Center, 30521 Hannover, Germany · JLCCNC Booth : Hall 17, Stand B12 (together with JLCPCB) · Exhibits : 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Mechanical Components , PCB, PCBA, PCB Design Software Development 1. Exhibition Background As one of the world's largest and most influential industrial events, Hannover Messe has always been the wind vane for global industrial automation, digital manufacturing and sustainable industrial development. With the theme of ‘Energising A Sustainable Industry’, this year's fair focuses on green energy, intelligent manufacturing and sustainable development, and attracts many global leading enterprises and experts to gather and discuss the new trends of future industry. 2. About JLC Global JLC Global is a comprehensive technology company dedicated to promoting industrial intelligence and digital transformation. The company focuses on the R&D and production of 3D printing, CNC machining, automated production, and the whole industry chain of electronic manufacturing such as PCB and PCBA. Relying on strong technological strength and innovative R&D capabilities, JLC Global continues to provide efficient and accurate manufacturing solutions for global customers and leads the industry with continuous technological innovation. In recent years, JLC Global has made remarkable achievements in the field of intelligent manufacturing and green production, and has successfully implemented a number of major projects to create a sustainable and efficient production system for its customers. 3. Exhibition Highlights and Product/Technology Details In this Hannover Messe, JLC Global will comprehensively display the core technologies and innovative products of its entire business line, specifically including: CNC Machining : The company will display advanced CNC machining systems to ensure efficient and accurate parts machining capability. 3D Printing : Showcasing high-precision, rapid prototyping 3D printing technology to meet diversified industrial manufacturing needs. Mechanical Components : JLC Mechatronic Components Marketplace integrates various mechatronic parts, aiming to provide a one-stop service for factory automation. PCB & PCBA : Showcasing the whole industry chain services from PCB design, manufacturing to assembly, helping the rapid iteration of electronic products. PCB Design Software Development : Introducing self-developed PCB design software to enhance design efficiency and product innovation. At the exhibition site, visitors will have the opportunity to fully understand JLC Global's innovations in process, technology and products, and deeply experience the company's all-round solutions in the field of intelligent manufacturing through interactive experience. 4. More Information For more exhibition activities and the latest news of JLCCNC, please visit our official website and follow our official social media platforms. We will be arranging on-site experts to answer questions and provide technical demonstrations, and we sincerely invite all professionals to come and exchange views, and witness the future changes of industrial technology together. If you have CNC machining needs, click to get a free quote for our cnc machining services. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice Press Release Sep 15, 2026 Table of Contents Production & Delivery Notes JLCCNC Holiday Schedule Logistics Companies Schedule Plan Ahead for Smooth Delivery Dear Customers, JLCCNC factories will be closed for holidays on September 25, September 27, and October 1–4, 2026 . During these dates, factory production and related operations will be temporarily suspended. During these non-working dates, factory production and shipping carrier pickups will be temporarily suspended. Normal production and dispatch will fully resume on October 5, 2026 . To avoid unexpected project delays, we strongly recommend placing time-sensitive orders at least 3–5 business days prior to the holiday closures. Please refer to the detailed schedules below for the specific holiday and work arrangements. Production & Delivery Notes Ordering: Our online platform remains available for quotes and order placement. You can continue to submit orders as usual. Production: Production schedules will be adjusted during the holidays, and affected orders may experience extended lead times depending on the service and production line. Shipping: Shipping schedules may be affected by holiday arrangements and logistics service availability. Delivery may take longer than usual for some orders. Lead Time: Production lead times may be affected by holiday arrangements. Please expect possible delays or adjustments to delivery dates during the holiday period. JLCCNC Holiday Schedule September： October： Logistics Companies Schedule September： October： Plan Ahead for Smooth Delivery Due to the cumulative order volume during factory closures, lead times immediately following the holiday period may be slightly longer than standard turnaround times. This update reflects JLCCNC’s ongoing commitment to providing a clearer and more accessible platform for engineers, designers, and manufacturing professionals worldwide. As part of this upgrade, JLCCNC has optimized the structure and usability of several core informational sections, including: ● About Us ● Coupons ● Help Center ● News ● Blog In addition, all existing product and service pages, including CNC machining and Sheet Metal pages, have been updated to improve content clarity and usability. JLCCNC has also added a new Customer Reviews & Testimonials page, enabling users to view real project experiences and feedback. Furthermore, all manufacturing process introduction pages have been comprehensively enhanced with clearer and more structured content, with a stronger focus on: ● Design guidelines ● Manufacturing workflows These improvements help users better understand JLCCNC’s machining and sheet metal capabilities during the design and quotation stages, enabling more informed manufacturing decisions. To further enhance accessibility, the website has been fully optimized for mobile devices, providing smoother navigation, improved readability, and a more consistent browsing experience across screens. JLCCNC welcomes user feedback and suggestions as part of its continuous platform improvement efforts. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCPCB at IMTS 2026: Powering End-to-End Electronics and Mechanical Innovation JLCPCB at IMTS 2026: Powering End-to-End Electronics and Mechanical Innovation Press Release Sep 09, 2026 Table of Contents About IMTS 2026 JLCPCB at IMTS 2026 Pre-Register & Visit Perks Discover the JLC Integrated Manufacturing Platform About JLC Technology Group As the manufacturing world gathers in Chicago for IMTS 2026 , we are excited to announce our participation at Booth #432271 in the West Building, Level 3 . From September 14 to 19, we invite engineers, designers, and industry leaders to discover how our integrated platform connects electronics design, manufacturing, and mechanical production in one seamless workflow. About IMTS 2026 The International Manufacturing Technology Show (IMTS) is the premier manufacturing technology event in the Western Hemisphere. IMTS 2026 brings together manufacturers, engineers, technology providers, and industry leaders from across the manufacturing sector, showcasing the latest advances in metalworking, additive manufacturing, automation, inspection, and digital manufacturing. JLCPCB at IMTS 2026 Date: September 14–19, 2026 Booth: #432271 | West Building, Level 3 Venue: McCormick Place Convention Center Address: 2301 S. King Drive, Chicago, IL 60616, USA Pre-Register & Visit Perks To celebrate our participation in IMTS 2026, we are offering exclusive rewards for our visitors and community members: 🎁 Pre-Register Online : Complete the pre-registration survey and get a $10 coupon → https://forms.gle/fyNS43vDrGZ469ds6 🎁 Visit Our Booth : Stop by JLCPCB Booth #432271 to get an additional $15 coupon, an exclusive gift for pre-registered visitors, and other free JLCPCB gifts onsite. 💬 Meet the JLCPCB Team : Connect face-to-face with the JLCPCB team, ask questions, and get insights tailored to your order needs. Discover the JLC Integrated Manufacturing Platform At our booth, visitors will discover how we streamline the entire product development journey—from initial concept to final production—under one digital roof. Our five core business lines work together to accelerate your R&D and reduce time‑to‑market: EasyEDA (PCB Design Software): Design seamlessly with our free, cloud-based EDA tool, with access to over 1 million components JLCPCB (Electronics Manufacturing): Accelerate development with 1–32 layer advanced PCB fabrication, stencils, turnkey SMT assembly, and global component sourcing. JLC3DP (3D Printing Solutions): Rapid, cost-effective industrial 3D printing across SLA, SLS, MJF, FDM, SLM, WJP, and BJ with high-performance plastics, nylons, resins, and metals. JLCCNC (CNC Machining & Sheet Metal): High-precision custom parts on demand, featuring 3- to 5-axis CNC milling, turning, EDM, and complete sheet metal fabrication. JLCMC (Automation Components): A vast marketplace for industrial automation, stocking 1M+ mechanical parts, linear motion components, sensors, motors, and more. About JLC Technology Group Founded in 2006, JLC Technology Group is a leading digital manufacturing platform committed to accelerating global hardware innovation. By seamlessly integrating EDA software, smart automated factories, and a reliable global supply-chain infrastructure, we proudly serve over 9.5 million engineers, businesses, and makers across 180+ countries. Join us this September in Chicago and let's shape the future of hardware together! Please be informed that due to the holiday, JLCCNC will adjust its operation and production schedules from June 19th to June 21st, 2026 . While our online platform remains fully operational, factory production capacities and shipping schedules will be partially affected during this period. Production & Delivery Notes: ● Ordering: Normal. You can place quotes and orders at any time as usual. ● Production: Suspended. Factory production lines will be paused on June 19th for most factories. The CNC factory will be paused on June 19th and June 21st . ● Shipping: Delayed. Regular dispatch will be suspended during the holiday and will resume progressively on June 22nd, 2026 . ● Lead Time: Postponed. The estimated lead time for all orders affected by the holiday will be extended by 1-3 days accordingly. JLCCNC Factories Holiday Schedule Logistics Companies Schedule Note：No impact on the In-stock Parts Service; in-stock parts are added to your library immediately after checkout. Customer Support Schedule Email and Livechat support will remain available on June 19th and June 20th, and will be suspended on June 21st. Warm Tip: To avoid any project delays caused by the holiday production pause and potential logistics bottlenecks, we highly recommend planning your schedule ahead and placing orders early. Thank you for your understanding and continuous support! The Lunar New Year holiday will span from January 23rd to February 4th . All CNC Machining materials will continue production during the LNY holiday, except for Steel 45#, SUS304. Spray Painting service is unavailable . Note: The build time might be 2-3 days longer than usual during the LNY holiday. During the Lunar New Year holiday, 3D printing and CNC machining orders cannot be combined for shipping, nor can they be combined with PCB/Stencil orders. This will resume on February 5th. Below is the production and shipping schedule. Please kindly schedule the order placement time properly to guarantee the timely completion of your projects. Factory & Shipping Schedule: Order Schedule for reference: Notes: · There is no shipping pickup service on Sunday, January 19th. · The 'Confirm Date' is the day when your order's manufacturing data is complete and the order is prepared for production. events.before: Home Newsroom Service Availability during the Annual Spring Festival Service Availability during the Annual Spring Festival Press Release Jan 27, 2026 Table of Contents Available Services During Spring Festival Holiday Order Placement Notes The Spring Festival (Lunar New Year) is approaching, and we are so grateful for your support over the past year. The Spring Festival holiday will span from February 10 to February 23 . JLC will continue to support your manufacturing needs during the Spring Festival holiday. We will provide the same high-quality manufacturing services for PCB, PCBA, 3D Printing, CNC machining, and mechatronic parts sourcing , and more . Below are the available services during the holiday, along with the production and shipping schedule. We recommend scheduling order placement in advance to help ensure timely project completion. Production & Shipping Schedule: Order Placement Schedule (For Reference): Available Services During Spring Festival Holiday CNC Machining All CNC machining materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for Steel 45# and SUS304 . Spray painting , mirror polishing , transparent polishing and blue-tinted transparent polishing services will be unavailable. Please note the following limitations during the holiday period: · The maximum supported part size is 500 × 500 × 200 mm . · Parts with highly complex structures requiring 5-axis machining are not supported. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. Sheet Metal Sheet Metal Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. PCB & PCBA Services Notes: Build times may be extended by around 2 days during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-Stencil Service SMT-stencil orders will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-stencil build time: 3 days Parts Orders Types Production Availability JLCPCB In-stock Parts No impact on order processing. JLCPCB Pre-order Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Global Sourcing Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from outside Mainland China) Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from Mainland China) No impact on order processing. Flexible Heater Flexible Heater Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . PCB Layout PCB Layout Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . 3D Printing All 3D printing materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for the BJ-316L material. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. JLCMC- Mechatronic Parts Service Types Shipping Availability In-stock Parts Can be shipped during the Spring Festival holiday, except February 16 to February 19. Back-orders Parts Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. API Application (JLCAPI.com) The API applications submitted between February 10 and February 24 will be reviewed on February 24, 2026. Order Placement Notes 1. Orders scheduled for production from February 2 to February 23 cannot be combined with orders scheduled for production after the holiday. 2. During the Spring Festival holiday, the order combining rules are as follows: · PCB / PCBA / Stencil: Can be combined and shipped together, but cannot be combined with other product types. · 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Sheet Metal, Flexible Heater, Mechatronic Parts: Must be ordered separately. 3. Except for New User Coupons and after-sales compensation coupons, all other coupons will be temporarily unavailable during the Spring Festival holiday, and their validity periods will be extended accordingly. 4. The Spring Festival holiday will span from February 10 to February 23 . JLC will continue to support your manufacturing needs during the Spring Festival holiday. We will provide the same high-quality manufacturing services for PCB, PCBA, 3D Printing, CNC machining, and mechatronic parts sourcing , and more . Below are the available services during the holiday, along with the production and shipping schedule. We recommend scheduling order placement in advance to help ensure timely project completion. Production & Shipping Schedule: Order Placement Schedule (For Reference): Available Services During Spring Festival Holiday CNC Machining All CNC machining materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for Steel 45# and SUS304 . Spray painting , mirror polishing , transparent polishing and blue-tinted transparent polishing services will be unavailable. Please note the following limitations during the holiday period: · The maximum supported part size is 500 × 500 × 200 mm . · Parts with highly complex structures requiring 5-axis machining are not supported. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. Sheet Metal Sheet Metal Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. PCB & PCBA Services Notes: Build times may be extended by around 2 days during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-Stencil Service SMT-stencil orders will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-stencil build time: 3 days Parts Orders Types Production Availability JLCPCB In-stock Parts No impact on order processing. JLCPCB Pre-order Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Global Sourcing Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from outside Mainland China) Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from Mainland China) No impact on order processing. Flexible Heater Flexible Heater Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . PCB Layout PCB Layout Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . 3D Printing All 3D printing materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for the BJ-316L material. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. JLCMC- Mechatronic Parts Service Types Shipping Availability In-stock Parts Can be shipped during the Spring Festival holiday, except February 16 to February 19. Back-orders Parts Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. API Application (JLCAPI.com) The API applications submitted between February 10 and February 24 will be reviewed on February 24, 2026. Order Placement Notes 1. Orders scheduled for production from February 2 to February 23 cannot be combined with orders scheduled for production after the holiday. 2. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for FreeCAD PCBWay Plug-In for FreeCAD by: Anson Jul 29,2022 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in CNC Machining FreeCAD CNC machining 3D printing Sheet metal Injection molding Send your 3D design to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. PCBWay's 3D & CNC services always well received by our customers. Now we have an in-depth cooperation with FreeCAD. FreeCAD is an open-source parametric 3D modeler made primarily to design real-life objects of any size. It is widely used among engineers. Now when you complete the 3D design on FreeCAD, you can place an order on PCBWay with just one click. FreeCAD will pass step files to us. You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files (usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before production. Installation from the official FreeCAD tools Just click the "tools" ----“Addon manager”---Choose the "PCBWay” from the selection list, click and install it. Manual installation You can also download the latest file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-FreeCAD , then click the "Macro", put the python file in the path, and click the “execute“ As a sponsor of FreeCAD, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Be Part of the PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest! by: PCBWay Sep 03,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News We are glad to announce that PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest has arrived. Prior to this, PCBWay successfully held six design contests. In each contest, we saw many eye-catching projects shared by outstanding and creative electronic engineers and enthusiasts. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest will continue the previous purpose, which is to encourage more and more people to explore the charm of electronic design and participate in it. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . In this contest, in addition to the two themes of Electronic Project and Mechanical Project that have appeared before, we also introduced STM32 Project, hoping to give designers more room to perform. The contest will start on September 2nd, 2024, and project submissions will be accepted until January 19th, 2025. After this, the judging phase will begin, and the final winners will be announced on the PCBWay Blog on March 10th, 2025. Two ways to participate in the contest: Go to the contest page, find the Participate Now button and click it. In this case, the submitted project will automatically be entered into the competition; participants only need to select the theme of entry. Please note that if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. After filling in all the project information, simply click "Submit" at the bottom of the page. Go to the SharedProject Community ( https://www.pcbway.com/project/shareproject/ ) and click Create a project. Select the theme you are going to participate in. Similarly, if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. Hint: Sharing complete project files, including Gerber, BOM, Centroid file, schematics, 3D files, and so on will increase the chances of receiving a higher score. Awards and corresponding prizes: The First Prize : 1 winner, $1500 Cash + $200 Coupon + A Palm-sized Robot Dog*1 The Second Prize : 2 winners, $1000 Cash + $100 Coupon + Raspberry Pi 5 4GB *1 The Third Prize : 3 winners, $500 Cash + $50 Coupon + OpenMV4 H7 R2 Cam Smart Camera *1 Popular Design Prize : 10 winners, $100 Cash + $20 Coupon + $10 3D Printing Coupon + Multimeter ZTY890DPro *1 Participation Prize : Raspberry Pi Pico * 1 STM32 Great Project Prize : Six-Claw Multifunctional Aluminum Alloy Soldering Table *1 For more detailed information about the contest, please refer to: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . If there are any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment below.We wish you the best of luck and look forward to your innovative designs! Verify Now Blog > Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay by: PCBWay May 30,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay recognizes the significant role it plays within the supply chain and broader society, along with the potential impact of its operations. To this end, we have established and strictly enforce the following principles, which not only govern our own conduct but also set clear expectations for our partners. Our goal is to ensure full legal and regulatory compliance, promote long-term sustainability, and generate a positive impact on society. Human Rights and Labor Protection No employment of individuals below the legal working age; all forms of forced or bonded labor are strictly prohibited. Discrimination and harassment in the workplace are not tolerated; an inclusive work environment for persons with disabilities is encouraged. Employees must be provided with fair compensation and reasonable rest periods, and their rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining must be respected. Business Ethics and Compliance Offering, promising, soliciting, or accepting any form of bribery is strictly prohibited; effective conflict of interest management and whistleblowing mechanisms must be in place. All financial and business records must accurately, completely, and truthfully reflect the underlying transactions. Full compliance with international sanctions, export controls, and other applicable laws and regulations is required. Supply Chain Responsibility and Sustainable Procurement PCBWay and its partners are required to extend the principles outlined in this document to all levels of entities within the supply chain. Priority should be given to selecting partners that are legally compliant, socially responsible, and committed to sustainable development. Identify social, labor, and environmental risks related to operations, and develop corresponding control and mitigation measures. Encourage partners to prioritize local sourcing to support regional economic development and job creation. Environmental Protection and Workplace Safety Actively implement environmental protection measures and continuously promote energy conservation and emission reduction; Ensure that all waste and hazardous materials are disposed of in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. The procurement or use of prohibited materials is not allowed. Provide employees with a safe working environment and health support mechanisms to prevent occupational injuries and health risks. PCBWay has fully adopted the DHL GoGreen transportation service in 2025 to reduce carbon emissions in the supply chain and promote the development of a green supply chain, with an initial target of reducing emissions by 30%. Information Protection and Transparent Governance Establish a comprehensive security system to strictly protect the confidentiality of customer data, drawings, and other business information. Comply with relevant laws and regulations to safeguard the personal data of customers and employees. Ensure that financial records are true, accurate, and complete, and prohibit any illegal activities. PCBWay will ensure the implementation of the above principles in actual cooperation and reserves the right to take action against any violations. This document provides a structured overview of PCB manufacturing and assembly capabilities, making it easier for engineers and sourcing teams to make informed decisions. You’ll find detailed information on: PCB Types & Technologies: Including multilayer PCBs, HDI boards, rigid-flex, and advanced structures Manufacturing Capabilities: Line width/spacing, minimum drill size, copper thickness, and board thickness Materials & Surface Finishes: FR4, high-frequency materials, ENIG, HASL, and more PCB Assembly (PCBA) Services: Turnkey assembly, component sourcing, and testing capabilities Quality Standards & Certifications: Designed to meet industrial-grade and high-reliability requirements Why Download This Brochure? Instead of searching through scattered information or going back and forth with technical questions, this brochure helps you: Quickly evaluate whether your design meets manufacturing capabilities Understand key process limitations early in the design stage Streamline supplier selection Improve communication efficiency and reduce iteration cycles It’s a practical reference for both design and sourcing decisions. When an individual or company purchases goods from an overseas supplier, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) considers them the ultimate importer. The ultimate importer can clear the goods or have a Customs Broker clear them on their behalf. If the supplier hires a carrier that provides door to door service, the carrier service usually has brokers in their supply chain to clear the goods on behalf of the ultimate importer. If a formal entry is required, CBP regulations require the broker to put the ultimate importer's identification number on the CBP Form 7501- Entry Summary. The ultimate importer's identification number is either the Employers Identification Number (EIN) tax identification number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) or the importer's social security number. The EIN is issued for the purpose of tax administration and are not intended for participation in any other activities (e.g., tax lien auction or sales, lotteries). For additional information about EIN, please visit the IRS web page "Apply for an Employer Identification (EIN) Online." Goods are usually cleared informally when they are for personal use, under $2500 in value, and are not in commercial quantities. A formal entry is usually required for commercial importations valued over $2,500. Because many foreign merchants are aware that CBP requires an identification number for the ultimate importer for formal entries, they will often request the purchaser's social security number to include on export documents that the broker will subsequently rely on to prepare the CBP entry. It should be noted that paperwork for goods sent by courier service does ask for an importer number, whether the import qualifies for an informal entry or not. Courier services file CBP entries electronically, and the software system they use requires an identification number to be provided for the recipient of the goods. If an identification number is not provided, the courier service is required to file a paper entry, which is extremely time-consuming and in the world of "Overnight Delivery" not practical. The end result is that most courier services will not accept packages for international delivery to U.S. residents if a recipient's identification number is not provided by the shipper. Goods sent through the international postal service that are under $2500 in value generally do not require an importer number to be cleared through CBP. Note: Regarding why your social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number is needed when shipping, please check out this official article for explanation: Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? ============================================================================================== by the way： Importers - Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? When an individual or company purchases goods from an overseas supplier, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) considers them the ultimate importer. The ultimate importer can clear the goods or have a Customs Broker clear them on their behalf. If the supplier hires a carrier that provides door to door service, the carrier service usually has brokers in their supply chain to clear the goods on behalf of the ultimate importer. If a formal entry is required, CBP regulations require the broker to put the ultimate importer's identification number on the CBP Form 7501- Entry Summary. The ultimate importer's identification number is either the Employers Identification Number (EIN) tax identification number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) or the importer's social security number. The EIN is issued for the purpose of tax administration and are not intended for participation in any other activities (e.g., tax lien auction or sales, lotteries). For additional information about EIN, please visit the IRS web page "Apply for an Employer Identification (EIN) Online." Goods are usually cleared informally when they are for personal use, under $2500 in value, and are not in commercial quantities. A formal entry is usually required for commercial importations valued over $2,500. Because many foreign merchants are aware that CBP requires an identification number for the ultimate importer for formal entries, they will often request the purchaser's social security number to include on export documents that the broker will subsequently rely on to prepare the CBP entry. It should be noted that paperwork for goods sent by courier service does ask for an importer number, whether the import qualifies for an informal entry or not. Courier services file CBP entries electronically, and the software system they use requires an identification number to be provided for the recipient of the goods. If an identification number is not provided, the courier service is required to file a paper entry, which is extremely time-consuming and in the world of "Overnight Delivery" not practical. The end result is that most courier services will not accept packages for international delivery to U.S. residents if a recipient's identification number is not provided by the shipper. Goods sent through the international postal service that are under $2500 in value generally do not require an importer number to be cleared through CBP. Meet PCBWay at electronica 2024! by: PCBWay Oct 18,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Once again, we welcome the famous technology event electronica in Munich, Germany! Since the first exhibition was held in 1964, electronica has gradually grown and now covers the entire world of electronics, including the micro- and nano-worlds of semiconductor and micro systems technology, as well as measurement and sensor technology, display technology and vehicle electronics, etc., which is the best choice for any technology enthusiasts and industry practitioners. PCBWay has participated in theelectronica many times and has received a warm response every time. At the exhibition, everyone has the opportunity to get close to our various products and fully evaluate the performance and quality of our products, which is far beyond the scope of online communication. On-site interaction gives us the opportunity to answer everyone's questions in a timely manner and help them understand the products more comprehensively, thereby accelerating the process of cooperation. Therefore, after the exhibition, we not only strengthened our cooperation with existing customers, but also successfully attracted the attention of many new potential partners. PCBWay will certainly not be absent from this year's exhibition.In addition, in order to give everyone a better exhibition experience and also to show how much importance PCBWay attaches to this exhibition, this year we made some innovations: Time: 2024.11.12-2024.11.15 Location: Trade Fair Center Messe München, Germany PCBWay Booth No.: A1.163 Highlights: Color- printed Boards In addition to the PCB series products, 3D printed parts and sheet metal parts that we have been displaying in the past, we will also bring the latest color-printed board samples. This new product has attracted the attention and interest of many customers, so we hope to take this opportunity to let everyone experience the excellent effect and quality of the color-printed board in person. New Booth We focused on designing the on-site booth as well. We expanded the booth area to 5m x 14m, providing a larger activity space, and also improved the sophistication of various details, in order to make the overall atmosphere more professional and make everyone's visiting experience more comfortable. The final booth design renderings are as follows: Gifts We will also bring some small gifts to the exhibition, including water cups, neck masks, and T-shirts. Welcome to come and get them! Map: Also, we've prepared some free tickets, click the link and apply for them! https://tickets.messe-muenchen.de/MM/ELE24/Register/PCBWay_2024 Sorry, the 100+ current tickets are "sold out". We welcome you to our booth to receive gifts PCBWay will continue the past successful experience, bring more innovative products and solutions. We welcome you to visit our booth and witness PCBWay's innovation and growth! We’ve got everything ready, just wait for your arrival. ;) Exhibition Moments Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad by: PCBWay Oct 11,2023 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Recently, PCBWay added a plug-in called PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit to Kicad: With just one click of the mouse, four files can be exported from the layout file automatically: Gerber file, IPC-Netlist file, BOM file and Pick and Place file, which can significantly improves the efficiency of pre-production work. Installation from the Official KiCad Repositories After installation, the plugin will appear on the right side of the navigation bar. And users can use it to export all the production files with just a click. Process demonstration： Sending the files to PCBWay, and they can be used for production after being reviewed by the staff. Note: If you want to place an assembly order, please be sure to add MPN information to the BOM. This can help the quoter source the devices you need more accurately. Manual installation Except for the way mentioned before, you can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Fabrication-Toolkit-for-KiCad: Open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About BOM Through BOM files, we can get all information of the components used in your design. In order to speed up the quotation process, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) If you have more suggestions, please leave a message below, PCBWay has committed to providing everyone with high-quality services. Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac.
